response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates extensive senior-level experience in software development, architecture, and team leadership across diverse industries (IT consulting, geospatial platforms, investment tech), with a strong focus on open-source technologies and Linux-based systems. His technical breadth (TypeScript, Node.js, Python, DLang, Java, C++) and leadership in mentoring teams align well with the role. However, his German language proficiency (basic) falls short of the required C1 level, and his recent experience lacks explicit UML or IT security governance, which are critical for the Head of Development role.
strengths: Extensive senior leadership in software development and IT architecture across multiple domains
Strong open-source contributions (GISCollective, Fluent-Asserts) and Linux proficiency
Proven track record in mentoring teams and adopting modern development practices (TDD, CI/CD)
concerns: German language proficiency does not meet the required C1 level (only basic)
Limited explicit experience with UML modeling and IT security governance
Recent roles (re:cinq, Optilyz) focus more on engineering than strategic leadership

key_factors.factor: Senior leadership and team management experience
